Refined muted ivory, sage, blue-grey and warm wood technical spatial diagram. Four orthographic architectural elevations with consistent height references, door/window outlines and fixed furniture. No people, animals, character reflections, advertising or invented real-world measurements. This is a concept set-design reconstruction; inferred dimensions and hidden areas remain explicitly marked as proposals. Text-to-image wording is reconstructed documentation, not the original production tool input.
